summary_text: Of 56 total findings released this period, 14 touch goals in UK Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum's remit. Goals in remit: customer_protection, disclosure, governance, safety. The findings span the harness sources: GSPC axis 8: care, GSPC axis 11: art5-safeguard, GSPC axis 6: openness, GSPC axis 21: sycophancy (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 14: jail, GSPC axis 16: oversight (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 1: governance, GSPC axis 2: safety, GSPC axis 20: deception (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 13: affect.

outreach_pack.cover_letter:
Dear UK Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum,

This is a permissionless, openly-licensed measurement crosswalk for the period September 2026. Every figure is reproducible from the linked artifacts; every linked artifact carries a sha256 and an OpenTimestamps stamp. The CSOAI substrate does not certify, accredit, or rate — it measures, signs, and records. Please treat this as raw observation; we welcome challenge on method, scope, and conclusion.

Best,
Nicholas Templeman
Founder, CSOAI
